$schema_note: Copy this file to your project as .preflight/config.json and edit for your project.
_comment_rubric: Path (string) or paths (array) to review rubrics. Array form enables multi-rubric modes: ["rubric-api-design.md", "rubric-generic.md"]. If omitted, plugin defaults are used based on mode.
_comment_capture: Paths for the self-improvement capture files. Created on first use.
_comment_branch: base = the protected target branch; remote = the intended push target. forbiddenRemotes/forbiddenRepos are an EXPLICIT denylist the pre-push guard checks the RESOLVED target against, REGARDLESS of 'remote' — set these on a clone whose 'origin' (or any remote) points at a legacy/production repo that must never be pushed to. forbiddenRemotes = remote NAMES; forbiddenRepos = owner/repo slugs or full URLs. Guard is agent-Bash-tool-only and fail-open (empty lists = inert) — not server-side protection.

test._comment: Command to run tests. Auto-detected if null (dotnet test for .NET, npm test for Node).
